final: WITH g AS (SELECT p.Diagnosis AS disease, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY p.Diagnosis), t AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS s FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS avg_n FROM g) SELECT g.disease, g.n, CAST(g.n AS REAL) / t.s, g.n - a.avg_n FROM g, t, a WHERE g.n > a.avg_n ORDER BY g.n DESC
